note: Separate from qa/regressions.json. That file and PR #274 both append at the same closing bracket of the regressions array, so one combined list does not merge cleanly.

regressions.failure: migrateOpenAI returned the legacy alias when the canonical write failed or the stored bytes did not match the written value.
A locked keychain listed no accounts and a refused delete still reported the secret removed.
A failed write-back dropped a legacy OpenAI secret that removal had already deleted.
A failed write-back left the deleted secret in the cache, so get returned it after the backend no longer held it.
Restoring the alias removed at load ignored a failed write, so the secret stayed deleted.
A canonical write that stored different bytes was still treated as a completed migration.
